title: Asaint - Swerve (feat. Attw 7even)
htmlContent:
Asaint team up with Attw 7even for a new single called "Swerve," an innovative record that shows the magic of an original sound. It stays out of falling in a box, by being it’s own wave of great music that sweeps the listener. If you love good creative music, you will have infinite reasons to love this special piece of art that doesn’t disappoint.
